summary: Taoyuan's own 2026 programme (official 環保局 notice dated 2026-01-06): up to NT$15,000 for scrapping a two-stroke scooter and buying electric, up to NT$12,000 for scrapping a pre-2017 phase 1-5 scooter, up to NT$4,000 for a plain new electric purchase (6,000 general places). Add-ons: low/middle-low income or 復興區 +10,000; families with a child aged 0-12 +6,000 (2,500 places); age 36-45 +4,000; age 18-35 +1,000; indigenous +1,000; delivery riders +3,000; watch-team members +5,000. The advertised NT$44,000 is a city-only theoretical ceiling, not typical, and the official page does not say it includes central subsidies or whether they stack. Applicants must be 18+ and registered in Taoyuan by 2024-12-31. Buy by 2026-12-31, apply by 2027-01-10. Whether places remain is unknown. Amounts are 'up to' and not split by vehicle class. 2027 plan not announced. Parking, charging and licence perks not found.
